items.name: Caterpillar
items.headline: Reports Q3 sales and revenues of $20.7B and operating margin of 20.4%
items.catalyst: Q3 total sales and revenues were $20.682B versus $17.638B; profit per share $7.13 versus $4.88.
items.thesis: Operating profit rose to $4.214B from $3.052B. The release gives no numeric outlook.
items.source_name: Caterpillar Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.name: Cognizant
items.headline: Sets 2026 revenue and adjusted EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $5,664M versus $5,415M; 2026 guidance is revenue of $22.05B-$22.14B and adjusted diluted EPS of $5.72-$5.79.
items.thesis: The company says adjusted operating margin should be about 16.1%, and it repurchased $258M of stock in Q3.
items.source_name: Cognizant Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.name: Incyte
items.headline: Raises 2026 net sales guidance; Q3 GAAP loss on acquired R&D charge
items.catalyst: Total net sales guidance is now $5,210M-$5,300M, up from $5,130M-$5,260M; Q3 GAAP diluted EPS was $(3.86).
items.thesis: The loss reflects a one-time $1.23B IPR&D expense tied to the Vega Therapeutics acquisition; Q3 revenues rose to $1,557.2M from $1,366.0M.
items.source_name: Incyte Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.name: Microsoft
items.headline: Posts fiscal Q1 revenue of $92.3B with Microsoft Cloud at $63.9B
items.catalyst: Revenue was $92,279M versus $77,673M and GAAP diluted EPS $4.92 versus $3.72, per the company's release.
items.thesis: Microsoft Cloud revenue was $63.9B, up 30% (31% in constant currency).

items.name: Alphabet
items.headline: Google Cloud revenue passes $30B as Q3 results land
items.catalyst: Q3 revenues were $127,577M versus $102,346M; Google Cloud revenues were $30,709M versus $15,157M.
items.thesis: Diluted EPS fell to $2.12 from $2.87; the release attributes $0.55 of the decline to an $8.7B loss on equity securities.

items.name: Boston Scientific
items.headline: Guides Q4 net sales down 1%-3% after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 net sales were $5.138B versus $5.065B; adjusted EPS was $0.73 versus $0.75.
items.thesis: Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS is guided to $3.16-$3.18, and Q4 net sales are guided to a decline of about 3.0% to 1.0%.
